title: French interior minister vows crackdown on illegal raves after thousands gather at military site
summary: French Interior Minister Laurent Nunez vowed on Sunday to crack down on illegal raves as he visited the area in central France where a massive free party was held on a military base despite authorities' warnings about the risk of unexploded mortars.
